## Masking makes every mode talk to its neighbours {.nka-slide data-prevent-swipe="true"}

```{=html}
<div id="nka-root">
<style>
#nka-root { --ink:#22262b; --mut:#7b838c; --acc:#c0392b; --acc2:#2471a3;
            --band:#e8eef4; font-size:28px; color:var(--ink); position:relative; }
#nka-root .nka-cap { font-size:30px; color:var(--mut); min-height:1.4em; margin:0 0 6px 0; }
#nka-root .nka-cap b { color:var(--ink); font-weight:600; }
#nka-root .nka-eq { display:flex; gap:26px; align-items:center; font-size:30px;
                    margin:2px 0 6px 0; }
#nka-root .nka-eq div { opacity:.3; transition:opacity .3s; padding:4px 16px;
                        border-left:6px solid transparent; white-space:nowrap; }
#nka-root .nka-eq div.on { opacity:1; border-left-color:var(--acc); background:#fbf1ef; }
#nka-root .nka-ctl { position:absolute; bottom:-18px; right:0; display:flex;
                     align-items:center; gap:18px; font-size:26px; }
#nka-root button { font:inherit; font-size:26px; padding:6px 20px; border-radius:8px;
                   border:2px solid var(--ink); background:#fff; color:var(--ink); cursor:pointer; }
#nka-root button:disabled { opacity:.3; cursor:default; }
#nka-root .dots span { display:inline-block; width:12px; height:12px; border-radius:50%;
                       background:#cfd5db; margin:0 4px; }
#nka-root .dots span.on { background:var(--acc); }
#nka-root .nka-slider { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; font-size:26px; }
#nka-root input[type=range] { width:280px; }
#nka-root canvas { image-rendering:pixelated; border:1px solid #cfd5db; }
#nka-root #nka-side { font-size:28px; color:var(--mut); margin-top:10px; }
#nka-root .mlab { font-size:27px; text-align:center; color:var(--mut); margin-top:6px; }
#nka-root .mlab b { color:var(--ink); font-weight:600; display:block; font-size:29px; }
#nka-root .hidden { display:none; }
#nka-root .mcell canvas { display:block; }
#nka-root #scene2.solo #wE, #nka-root #scene2.solo #wD { display:none; }
#nka-root #scene2.solo #mrow { justify-content:flex-start; }
#nka-root #scene2.solo canvas { width:470px !important; height:470px !important; }
#nka-root.solo-mode #nka-side { position:absolute; left:600px; top:230px;
                                width:640px; font-size:32px; line-height:1.5; }
#nka-root .axlab { font-size:25px; color:var(--mut); }
</style>

<div class="nka-cap" id="nka-cap"></div>

<div class="nka-eq">
  <div id="eq1">\(\tilde a_k=\sum_{k'} W_{k-k'}\,a_{k'}\)</div>
  <div id="eq2">\(\langle \tilde C_k\rangle=\sum_{k'} M_{kk'}\,C_{k'}\)</div>
  <div id="eq3">\({\rm Cov}(\tilde C_k,\tilde C_{k'})\simeq C_{\bar k}C_{\bar k}\,\Xi_{kk'}(w_aw_c,w_bw_d)\)</div>
</div>

<div id="scene1">
  <svg id="svgA" viewBox="0 0 1730 300" width="1730" height="300"></svg>
  <svg id="svgB" viewBox="0 0 1730 350" width="1730" height="350"></svg>
</div>

<div id="scene2" class="hidden">
  <div style="display:flex; gap:34px; align-items:flex-start;" id="mrow">
    <div class="mcell" id="wE"><canvas id="cvE" style="width:460px;height:460px"></canvas>
      <div class="mlab"><b>exact</b>direct sum<br><span style="font-size:24px">k, k' = 2 … 72</span></div></div>
    <div class="mcell" id="wN"><canvas id="cvN" style="width:460px;height:460px"></canvas>
      <div class="mlab"><b>NKA</b>one mask-product kernel</div></div>
    <div class="mcell" id="wD"><canvas id="cvD" style="width:460px;height:460px"></canvas>
      <div class="mlab"><b>NKA &minus; exact</b>error</div></div>
  </div>
  <svg id="svgC" viewBox="0 0 1730 230" width="1730" height="230"></svg>
</div>

<div id="nka-side"></div>

<div class="nka-ctl">
  <div class="nka-slider hidden" id="fwrap">
    <label for="fslider">footprint</label>
    <input id="fslider" type="range" min="6" max="90" value="35">
    <span id="fval" style="width:3.6em; display:inline-block;">35%</span>
  </div>
  <span class="dots" id="dots"></span>
  <button id="prev">&larr;</button>
  <button id="next">&rarr;</button>
</div>
</div>

<script>
(function(){
  var R = document.getElementById('nka-root');
  if(!R) return;

  // ---------- config ----------
  var N   = 192;            // signed mode index -N/2 .. N/2-1
  var NX  = 512;            // real-space samples
  var KLO = 2, KHI = 73;    // modes shown in covariance matrices
  var NK  = KHI - KLO;      // 71
  var frac = 0.35;          // footprint fraction of the box

  function Cfun(k){ var a = Math.abs(k);
    return (1.0/Math.pow(1.0 + a/6.0, 1.6)) * (1 + 0.9*Math.exp(-Math.pow((a-26)/4,2))); }

  // deterministic PRNG
  function mulberry(a){ return function(){
    a |= 0; a = a + 0x6D2B79F5 | 0;
    var t = Math.imul(a ^ a >>> 15, 1 | a);
    t = t + Math.imul(t ^ t >>> 7, 61 | t) ^ t;
    return ((t ^ t >>> 14) >>> 0) / 4294967296; }; }
  function gauss(rng){
    var u = 1 - rng(), v = rng();
    return Math.sqrt(-2*Math.log(u)) * Math.cos(2*Math.PI*v); }

  // ---------- realise one Gaussian field a(x) (fixed seed) ----------
  var field = new Float64Array(NX);
  (function(){
    var rng = mulberry(20260903);
    for(var k=1;k<N/2;k++){
      var s = Math.sqrt(Cfun(k)/2), re = gauss(rng)*s, im = gauss(rng)*s;
      for(var j=0;j<NX;j++){
        var ph = 2*Math.PI*k*j/NX;
        field[j] += 2*(re*Math.cos(ph) - im*Math.sin(ph));
      }
    }
    var mx = 0; for(var j2=0;j2<NX;j2++) mx = Math.max(mx, Math.abs(field[j2]));
    for(var j3=0;j3<NX;j3++) field[j3] /= mx;   // scale to [-1,1] for drawing
  })();

  // ---------- mask, its transform, and derived quantities ----------
  var mask = new Float64Array(NX);
  var Wre  = new Float64Array(N), Wim = new Float64Array(N), sumP = 1;
  var Ctil = new Float64Array(N/2), Cin = new Float64Array(N/2);
  var covE = new Float64Array(NK*NK), covN = new Float64Array(NK*NK);

  function Wat(m, part){                       // m signed; 0 outside band
    if(m <= -N/2 || m >= N/2) return 0;
    var i = (m + N) % N;
    return part ? Wim[i] : Wre[i];
  }

  function buildMask(f){
    var taper = 0.015*NX, half = f*NX/2, mid = NX/2;
    for(var j=0;j<NX;j++){
      var d = Math.abs(j - mid);
      var v = 0;
      if(d <= half - taper) v = 1;
      else if(d < half + taper) v = 0.5*(1 + Math.cos(Math.PI*(d - half + taper)/(2*taper)));
      mask[j] = v;
    }
    // W_m = (1/NX) sum_j w_j exp(-2 pi i m j / NX)
    sumP = 0;
    for(var mi=0; mi<N; mi++){
      var m = mi < N/2 ? mi : mi - N, sr = 0, si = 0;
      for(var jj=0; jj<NX; jj++){
        var ph = 2*Math.PI*m*jj/NX;
        sr += mask[jj]*Math.cos(ph); si -= mask[jj]*Math.sin(ph);
      }
      Wre[mi] = sr/NX; Wim[mi] = si/NX;
      sumP += Wre[mi]*Wre[mi] + Wim[mi]*Wim[mi];
    }
    // coupled spectrum  <Ctil_k> = sum_k' |W_{k-k'}|^2 C_k' / sumP
    for(var k=0;k<N/2;k++){
      Cin[k] = Cfun(k);
      var acc = 0;
      for(var kp=-N/2; kp<N/2; kp++){
        var wr = Wat(k-kp,0), wi = Wat(k-kp,1);
        acc += (wr*wr + wi*wi)*Cfun(kp);
      }
      Ctil[k] = acc/sumP;
    }
    covariances();
  }

  function covariances(){
    // exact:  S_kk' = sum_k'' W_{k-k''} W*_{k'-k''} C_k''      Cov = 2|S|^2/sumP^2
    // NKA:    C_k'' -> C_{(k+k')/2}  =>  S = C_kbar * Xi_{k-k'}
    var Xre = new Float64Array(2*N), Xim = new Float64Array(2*N);   // Xi_delta, offset N
    for(var d=-N+1; d<N; d++){
      var ar=0, ai=0;
      for(var m=-N/2; m<N/2; m++){
        var wr1=Wat(d+m,0), wi1=Wat(d+m,1), wr2=Wat(m,0), wi2=Wat(m,1);
        ar += wr1*wr2 + wi1*wi2;      // W * conj(W)
        ai += wi1*wr2 - wr1*wi2;
      }
      Xre[d+N]=ar; Xim[d+N]=ai;
    }
    var n2 = sumP*sumP;
    for(var i=0;i<NK;i++){
      var k = KLO + i;
      for(var j=0;j<NK;j++){
        var kp = KLO + j, sr=0, si=0;
        for(var q=-N/2; q<N/2; q++){
          var a1r=Wat(k-q,0), a1i=Wat(k-q,1), a2r=Wat(kp-q,0), a2i=Wat(kp-q,1);
          var c = Cfun(q);
          sr += (a1r*a2r + a1i*a2i)*c;
          si += (a1i*a2r - a1r*a2i)*c;
        }
        covE[i*NK+j] = 2*(sr*sr + si*si)/n2;
        var cb = Cfun((k+kp)/2), dd = k-kp+N;
        var nr = cb*Xre[dd], ni = cb*Xim[dd];
        covN[i*NK+j] = 2*(nr*nr + ni*ni)/n2;
      }
    }
  }

  // ---------- drawing helpers ----------
  var NS = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
  function el(p, t, at){ var e = document.createElementNS(NS,t);
    for(var k in at) e.setAttribute(k, at[k]); p.appendChild(e); return e; }
  function txt(p, x, y, s, at){ var e = el(p,'text',
      Object.assign({x:x,y:y,'font-size':26,fill:'#22262b'}, at||{}));
    e.textContent = s; return e; }

  function divergent(v){                       // v in [-1,1]
    var t = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, v));
    if(t >= 0){ var u = Math.pow(t,0.55);
      return [255 - 210*u, 255 - 190*u, 255 - 100*u]; }        // white -> deep blue
    var u2 = Math.pow(-t,0.55);
    return [255 - 20*u2, 255 - 190*u2, 255 - 200*u2];          // white -> red
  }
  function heat(cv, mat, scale){
    cv.width = NK; cv.height = NK;
    var ctx = cv.getContext('2d'), im = ctx.createImageData(NK,NK);
    for(var i=0;i<NK;i++) for(var j=0;j<NK;j++){
      var c = divergent(mat[i*NK+j]/scale), o = 4*(i*NK+j);
      im.data[o]=c[0]; im.data[o+1]=c[1]; im.data[o+2]=c[2]; im.data[o+3]=255;
    }
    ctx.putImageData(im,0,0);
  }

  // ---------- panel A: real space ----------
  var PAD = 90, W1 = 1730, AW = W1 - PAD - 40;
  function drawA(step){
    var s = document.getElementById('svgA'); s.innerHTML = '';
    var y0 = 62, h = 200, mid = y0 + h/2;
    el(s,'line',{x1:PAD,y1:mid,x2:PAD+AW,y2:mid,stroke:'#dfe4e9','stroke-width':2});
    txt(s, 10, mid+9, 'a(x)', {fill:'#7b838c'});
    txt(s, PAD, 294, 'position  x', {fill:'#7b838c','font-size':26});

    if(step >= 2){                                  // footprint band
      var lo = PAD + AW*(0.5 - frac/2), hi = PAD + AW*(0.5 + frac/2);
      el(s,'rect',{x:lo,y:y0,width:hi-lo,height:h,fill:'#e8eef4'});
      el(s,'line',{x1:lo,y1:y0,x2:lo,y2:y0+h,stroke:'#2471a3','stroke-width':3});
      el(s,'line',{x1:hi,y1:y0,x2:hi,y2:y0+h,stroke:'#2471a3','stroke-width':3});
      txt(s,(lo+hi)/2 - 84, y0 - 22, 'mask w(x)', {fill:'#2471a3','font-size':27});
    }
    function path(scaleByMask, col, wid, op){
      var d = '';
      for(var j=0;j<NX;j++){
        var v = field[j]*(scaleByMask ? mask[j] : 1);
        d += (j?'L':'M') + (PAD + AW*j/(NX-1)).toFixed(1) + ' ' + (mid - v*h*0.44).toFixed(1) + ' ';
      }
      el(s,'path',{d:d,fill:'none',stroke:col,'stroke-width':wid,opacity:op});
    }
    if(step >= 2){
      path(false,'#b9c1c9',2,1); path(true,'#22262b',3,1);
      var lo2 = PAD + AW*(0.5 - frac/2);
      var ly = y0 - 22;
      el(s,'line',{x1:PAD,y1:ly-8,x2:PAD+46,y2:ly-8,stroke:'#b9c1c9','stroke-width':3});
      txt(s, PAD+58, ly, 'field  a', {fill:'#9aa2ab','font-size':28});
      el(s,'line',{x1:PAD+230,y1:ly-8,x2:PAD+276,y2:ly-8,stroke:'#22262b','stroke-width':3});
      txt(s, PAD+288, ly, 'observed  w·a', {fill:'#22262b','font-size':28});
      if(lo2 < 0) {}
    }
    else path(false,'#22262b',3,1);
  }

  // ---------- panel B: harmonic space ----------
  var kMark = 34;
  function drawB(step, kc){
    var s = document.getElementById('svgB'); s.innerHTML = '';
    if(step < 1){ return; }
    var x0 = PAD, y0 = 14, h = 272, w = AW, kmax = 84;
    var lgmin = Math.log10(Cfun(kmax)), lgmax = Math.log10(Cfun(1));
    function X(k){ return x0 + w*(k-1)/(kmax-1); }
    function Y(c){ return y0 + h*(1 - (Math.log10(c)-lgmin)/(lgmax-lgmin)); }
    el(s,'line',{x1:x0,y1:y0+h,x2:x0+w,y2:y0+h,stroke:'#dfe4e9','stroke-width':2});
    txt(s, x0, y0+h+44, 'wavenumber  k', {fill:'#7b838c'});
    txt(s, 4, y0+18, 'C\u2096', {fill:'#7b838c'});

    var d1='', d2='';
    for(var k=1;k<kmax;k++){
      d1 += (k>1?'L':'M') + X(k).toFixed(1) + ' ' + Y(Cin[k]).toFixed(1) + ' ';
      d2 += (k>1?'L':'M') + X(k).toFixed(1) + ' ' + Y(Ctil[k]).toFixed(1) + ' ';
    }
    el(s,'path',{d:d1,fill:'none',stroke:'#22262b','stroke-width':3.5});
    txt(s, X(58), Y(Cin[58])-22, 'true  C\u2096', {fill:'#22262b','font-size':28});

    if(step >= 4){
      el(s,'path',{d:d2,fill:'none',stroke:'#c0392b','stroke-width':3.5,
                   'stroke-dasharray':'10 7'});
      txt(s, X(58), Y(Ctil[58])+46, 'masked  C\u0303\u2096', {fill:'#c0392b','font-size':28});
    }
    // mask kernel centred on kc
    if(step < 3) return;
    var pk = 0, ker = [];
    for(var m=-N/2+1;m<N/2;m++){ var wr=Wat(m,0), wi=Wat(m,1); var p = wr*wr+wi*wi;
      ker.push([kc-m, p]); pk = Math.max(pk,p); }
    var dk = '';
    for(var i2=0;i2<ker.length;i2++){
      var kk = ker[i2][0]; if(kk < 0.5 || kk > kmax) continue;
      dk += (dk?'L':'M') + X(kk).toFixed(1) + ' ' + (y0+h - 175*ker[i2][1]/pk).toFixed(1) + ' ';
    }
    el(s,'path',{d:dk,fill:'none',stroke:'#2471a3','stroke-width':3.5});
    el(s,'line',{x1:X(kc),y1:y0,x2:X(kc),y2:y0+h,stroke:'#2471a3',
                 'stroke-width':2,'stroke-dasharray':'6 8'});
    txt(s, X(kc)+18, y0+26, 'mask kernel  |W|\u00b2', {fill:'#2471a3','font-size':28});
  }

  // ---------- panel C: does C vary across the kernel? (scene 2) ----------
  function drawC(){
    var s = document.getElementById('svgC'); s.innerHTML='';
    var x0 = PAD, y0 = 22, h = 132, w = AW, kmax = 84, kc = 12;
    var lgmin = Math.log10(Cfun(kmax)), lgmax = Math.log10(Cfun(1));
    function X(k){ return x0 + w*(k-1)/(kmax-1); }
    function Y(c){ return y0 + h*(1 - (Math.log10(c)-lgmin)/(lgmax-lgmin)); }
    var d='';
    for(var k=1;k<kmax;k++) d += (k>1?'L':'M')+X(k).toFixed(1)+' '+Y(Cfun(k)).toFixed(1)+' ';
    el(s,'path',{d:d,fill:'none',stroke:'#22262b','stroke-width':3.5});
    txt(s, X(62), Y(Cfun(62))-20, 'C\u2096', {fill:'#22262b','font-size':28});
    var pk=0, ker=[];
    for(var m=-N/2+1;m<N/2;m++){ var wr=Wat(m,0), wi=Wat(m,1), p=wr*wr+wi*wi;
      ker.push([kc-m,p]); pk=Math.max(pk,p); }
    var dk='';
    for(var i=0;i<ker.length;i++){ var kk=ker[i][0]; if(kk<0.5||kk>kmax) continue;
      dk += (dk?'L':'M')+X(kk).toFixed(1)+' '+(y0+h-100*ker[i][1]/pk).toFixed(1)+' '; }
    el(s,'path',{d:dk,fill:'none',stroke:'#2471a3','stroke-width':3.5});
    var lo=null, hi=null;
    for(var i3=0;i3<ker.length;i3++) if(ker[i3][1] > pk/2){
      var kk2=ker[i3][0]; if(lo===null||kk2<lo) lo=kk2; if(hi===null||kk2>hi) hi=kk2; }
    if(lo!==null){
      lo = Math.max(lo, 1); hi = Math.min(hi, kmax-1);
      el(s,'rect',{x:X(lo),y:y0,width:Math.max(X(hi)-X(lo),3),height:h,
                   fill:'#2471a3',opacity:0.12});
      var ratio = Cfun(lo)/Cfun(hi), bad = ratio > 1.5;
      el(s,'line',{x1:X(lo),y1:y0+h+28,x2:X(hi),y2:y0+h+28,
                   stroke: bad?'#c0392b':'#2471a3','stroke-width':4});
      txt(s, X(hi)+22, y0+h+38,
          '\u00d7' + ratio.toFixed(1) + ' across the kernel',
          {fill: bad?'#c0392b':'#2471a3', 'font-size':28});
    }
  }

  // ---------- scene 2 matrices ----------
  // shown as correlation matrices r = Cov / sqrt(diag_exact * diag_exact),
  // so the band stays visible at every k instead of being swamped by C_k^2.
  function drawMatrices(){
    var rE = new Float64Array(NK*NK), rN = new Float64Array(NK*NK),
        rD = new Float64Array(NK*NK), d = new Float64Array(NK);
    for(var i=0;i<NK;i++) d[i] = Math.sqrt(covE[i*NK+i]);
    for(var a=0;a<NK;a++) for(var b=0;b<NK;b++){
      var q = a*NK+b, nrm = d[a]*d[b];
      rE[q] = covE[q]/nrm; rN[q] = covN[q]/nrm; rD[q] = rN[q]-rE[q];
    }
    heat(document.getElementById('cvE'), rE, 1);
    heat(document.getElementById('cvN'), rN, 1);
    heat(document.getElementById('cvD'), rD, 0.35);
  }

  // ---------- step machine ----------
  var CAPS = ['one field, modes independent',
              'we see only part of it',
              'mask \u00d7 field  \u2192  kernel \u2217 modes',
              'the kernel smears the spectrum',
              'C flat across the kernel  \u2192  one kernel',
              'shrink the footprint'];
  var SIDE = ['','','','','',''];
  var NSTEP = 6, step = 0;
  var caps = document.getElementById('nka-cap'), side = document.getElementById('nka-side');
  var dots = document.getElementById('dots');
  for(var i=0;i<NSTEP;i++) dots.appendChild(document.createElement('span'));

  function render(){
    caps.innerHTML = CAPS[step]; side.innerHTML = SIDE[step];
    document.getElementById('eq1').className = (step===2||step===3) ? 'on' : '';
    document.getElementById('eq2').className = (step===3) ? 'on' : '';
    document.getElementById('eq3').className = (step>=4) ? 'on' : '';
    var s2 = step >= 4;
    document.getElementById('scene2').classList.toggle('solo', step === 4);
    R.classList.toggle('solo-mode', step === 4);
    document.getElementById('scene1').classList.toggle('hidden', s2);
    document.getElementById('scene2').classList.toggle('hidden', !s2);
    document.getElementById('fwrap').classList.toggle('hidden', step !== 5);
    for(var i=0;i<NSTEP;i++) dots.children[i].className = (i===step) ? 'on' : '';
    document.getElementById('prev').disabled = (step===0);
    document.getElementById('next').disabled = (step===NSTEP-1);
    if(s2){ drawMatrices(); drawC(); }
    else  { drawA(step+1); drawB(step+1, kMark); }
  }

  document.getElementById('next').onclick = function(){
    if(step < NSTEP-1){ step++; render(); } };
  document.getElementById('prev').onclick = function(){
    if(step > 0){ step--; render(); } };
  var sl = document.getElementById('fslider');
  sl.oninput = function(){
    frac = (+sl.value)/100;
    document.getElementById('fval').textContent = sl.value + '%';
    buildMask(frac); render();
  };

  buildMask(frac);
  render();
})();
</script>
```

::: {.notes}
This is the one piece of machinery all three papers share, so it's worth ten minutes.

Start with a Gaussian field on a line: every Fourier mode independent, covariance perfectly
diagonal. Then multiply by a mask — we only see part of the sky. In harmonic space that
multiplication becomes a convolution: each observed mode is a weighted sum of its neighbours,
with the weight set by the mask's transform. The kernel's width goes like one over the
footprint width — a big survey gives a narrow kernel.

Take the expectation and you get the mode-coupling matrix: the measured pseudo-spectrum is a
smeared version of the truth. That much is exact, and it's what NaMaster inverts.

The covariance is where it gets hard, because you get four W's and a sum you can't do. The
Narrow Kernel Approximation says: if the true spectrum barely changes across the kernel width,
evaluate it once at the mean of the two multipoles and pull it outside the sum. What's left
collapses into a single kernel — the transform of a *product* of masks. That's the whole trick,
and it's exactly the step that fails for catalogue masks, where the product of two delta combs
is zero.

Then shrink the footprint. The kernel widens, the spectrum is no longer flat across it, and the
off-diagonal band goes wrong — while the diagonal stays about right. That's the regime the
three papers care about.
:::
